changes.summary: Install the shared changelog library from GitHub
changes.body: Pin @codethread/cli-changelog to a full GitHub commit and record its integrity in bun.lock. Standard frozen-lockfile installs fetch the shared package for source, CI and Homebrew builds. Compiled executables bundle the dependency.

adoption.text: Run bun install --frozen-lockfile and rebuild the executable to use the GitHub-pinned dependency.

changes.summary: Use the shared CLI changelog library
changes.body: Load changelog schemas, version queries, pagination and rendering from the local @codethread/cli-changelog package. The compiled executable bundles the library.

adoption.text: For source builds, install dependencies in the cli-changelog checkout and run bun link there before installing this repository with bun install --frozen-lockfile. Compiled executables need no additional files.

changes.body: Build and install qlock from its own repository. Merge queues use Git directly and no longer require Honeycomb. Queue behavior, SQLite storage and existing lock paths are unchanged.

adoption.text: Install with Homebrew or build from source. Read README.md for installation commands; no project setup is required.

changes.summary: show queue tool release changes without joining a queue
changes.body:
Run `qlock changelog` for bundled release history and adoption instructions.
Version selection and paginated JSON output work without acquiring a lock.

changes.summary: Help explains queue admission timeouts and how to resume a retained ticket.
